The team based their claim on mathematical analysis of hundreds of hours of bonobo calls along with notes of the contexts in which they occurred.
questions.question: Which finding, if true, would best support the researchers’ claim?
options: Bonobos used a single yelp or a single peep as an imperative, but a yelp appeared to be closer to a command, while a peep tended to function as a suggestion.

Text 1
In parts of Papua New Guinea, people exchange strings of shell money and other valuables at weddings, funerals, and community ceremonies. Text 2
